name: slow-down
description: Keeps the engineer in the architect seat: Claude implements, you decide. Holds back architecture decisions until you make them, runs short design-defense checkpoints and keeps a decision log.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: light: only dependencies, schema and infra, checkpoint every ~400 changed lines. normal: all signals, every ~150 lines. deep: all signals, every ~50 lines.
